Home.title: SWS
Home.description: Are you looking for a reliable and professional construction company in the Netherlands? At Slimme Werkoplossingen & Services, we guarantee quality, durability and craftsmanship.
Home.windowRepairDescription: restoration and improvement of window frames and glass.
Home.paintingDescription: professional interior and exterior painting for a fresh look.
Home.technicalPainting: Technical painting of houses and enterprises
Home.woodworkingDescription: individual solutions in carpentry and repair of wooden structures.
Home.aboutText1: At Slimme Werkoplossingen & Services we specialise in quality construction and renovation work. With many years of experience and a passion for craftsmanship, we offer sustainable and aesthetic solutions for both private and business clients.
Home.aboutText2: We stand for reliability, precision and customer satisfaction. Whether it's a small repair or a large-scale project, we guarantee perfect execution and a high-quality end result.
Home.feedbackText: We spent a lot of time trying to find a decent building company to renovate our two-storey house. We had already had negative experiences with other 'professionals'. Friends advised us to contact this company and we have never regretted it. The repairs were completed in just 15 days. The workers did the painting quickly and efficiently. The service exceeded our expectations.
Home.feedback1Text: Our old windows were letting in cold air and needed complete renovation. SWS team replaced all the glass and repaired the frames perfectly. The insulation work was excellent - our energy bills dropped significantly. Very satisfied with the quality and speed of work!
Home.feedback2Text: We ordered custom furniture and wooden floor installation. The craftsmanship was outstanding! Every detail was perfect, from design consultation to final installation. The team was punctual, clean, and very professional. Our new interior looks fantastic!
Home.feedback3Text: Share your experience with our services! Tell us about the quality of work, professionalism of our team, and how we helped transform your space. Your feedback helps us improve and helps other clients make informed decisions.
Home.heroSpecialist: – your window, painting and woodworking specialist!
Home.aboutUsDesc: – Craftsmanship and quality in construction and renovation
Home.productInfoText1: Our flagship product combines cutting-edge technology with sleek design. Built with premium materials, it offers unparalleled performance and reliability.
Home.productInfoText2: Key features include advanced processing capabilities, and an intuitive user interface designed for both beginners and experts.
Home.shippingText1: We offer worldwide shipping through trusted courier partners. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days, while express shipping ensures delivery within 1-2 business days.
Home.shippingText2: All orders are carefully packaged and fully insured. Track your shipment in real-time through our dedicated tracking portal.
Home.returnText1: We stand behind our products with a comprehensive 30-day return policy. If you're not completely satisfied, simply return the item in its original condition.
Home.returnText2: Our hassle-free return process includes free return shipping and full refunds processed within 48 hours of receiving the returned item.
Home.faq1Answer: It depends on the condition and the materials. Send us a few photos or we can stop by for a quick look. After that, you’ll get a clear price with no surprises.
Home.faq2Answer: Small jobs can often start quickly. Bigger projects we plan together. After the first visit, we’ll give you a realistic timeline and stick to it.
Home.faq3Answer: Yes. If something isn’t right after the job is done, we’ll come back and fix it. No hassle.
Home.faq4Question: Do you work with your own materials?
Home.faq4Answer: Usually yes, because then we know the quality is good. If you have your own materials you want to use, we can check together if they’re suitable.
Home.faq5Answer: We cover everything properly and use dust extraction where possible. After the job, we clean up everything. No worries.
Home.faq6Question: Can we split the work into parts?
Home.faq6Answer: Sure. We can divide the project into phases or start with the most important part first.
Home.faq7Question: Can we see examples of your work?
Home.faq7Answer: Absolutely. We have photos, and if you want, we can share addresses where we’ve worked before.
Home.faq8Answer: There’s usually a small deposit for materials. The rest is paid after each phase is completed by us. Everything stays transparent.
